title: mdchart stat card fragment
description: The JSON body of a ```statcard fenced code block: an array of single-KPI cards rendered as a row.

value.description: The number itself, pre-formatted if it needs a unit/currency, e.g. '€51,200' or 1205.

delta.description: A signed comparison, e.g. '+8.1%' or '-3.2%'. Colors green/red by sign automatically -- omit `tone` when using this.

tone.description: Overrides the card's color for a value with no delta, e.g. a plain alert count that should read as urgent.
